obfuscation_indicators: variety of factors beyond our control
risk_summary: The excerpt is heavily boilerplate and broadly enumerates macroeconomic, credit, regulatory, technology, geopolitical, and operational risks without quantifying their probability or expected financial impact. Credit-loss allowances are explicitly dependent on subjective estimates and external conditions, while proposed interchange-fee changes could reduce related revenues by approximately 30% based on historical periods. The tone is cautious and legally protective rather than indicative of an immediate crisis.
